reviews.title: New addition of ads
reviews.text: This planner used to be amazing . With the addition of adds it has made it completely unusable .
This advertisement on half screen are not helping for users. If that will be continued I definitely delete this app.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: The free version of this app was amazing and was perfect for tracking my shifts but as of today (10th Sept 2026) the app has become unusable due to ads taking up 50% of the screen. The ads used to be small and at the bottom of the screen and were unobtrusive but now they are glaringly “in your face” and are making you buy the app.

reviews.title: Only good for work
reviews.text: This calendar is horrible for anything else other than work shifts you have set up already. It is difficult to add daily, yearly or random event or birthday etc.
